## Description {#details}

<p>Base class for the extensible RTTI hierarchy.</p>


<p>This class defines virtual methods, dynamicClassID and isA, that enable type comparisons.</p>


<p>Definition at line 69 of file <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/files/include/include/llvm/include/llvm/support/extensiblertti-h">ExtensibleRTTI.h</a>.</p>
